title: Stop template tokens rendering in the PDF, and fail the build if they ever do
source_handoff: third review round, P0: raw #registry-label / #registry-version tokens rendering in the PDF
acceptance_criteria: No template token renders in the PDF: the provenance table and title page name book/evidence/v4/claims.json, and the Chapter 18 heading reads (active v4 claims)

The six leak sites are fixed at source: main.typ title line, main.typ provenance table, main.typ Chapter 18 heading (currently a plain string argument, so never interpolated), main.typ index prose, chapters/evidence-and-reproduction.typ, concepts/cache-consistency.typ
Interpolation uses #raw(registry-label) where the page currently backticks the token, and string concatenation for the heading
book/build.sh fails the build when the extracted PDF text contains #registry-, #build-, #source-, ${, {{ or UNKNOWN_PLACEHOLDER, and records unresolved_tokens_in_pdf in the manifest
book/evidence/check.sh gains a fatal template-interpolation rule for a backticked or quoted build-input token in a source file
A negative control (one leak reintroduced) fails the build, with the output recorded
This review exchange is recorded, attributed, at book/evidence/reviews/20260924-edition-2-review-response--deepseek-flash.md, quoting the reviewer's reply
The two files the owner edited by hand in the completed book-evidence-v4 worktree are inspected, never blindly deleted or overwritten, and what was found is reported
validation: book/build.sh --out dist/preview.pdf verifies with no template token in the text
reintroducing one leak fails the build
